headlines.title: Shopify (SHOP) Could Be 17% Undervalued Following Its AI Checkout Push
headlines.summary: Shopify (SHOP) is back in focus after the launch of Shop Pay checkout with Meta’s Muse AI agent, a move that has coincided with a 33% jump in the share price over the past month. Shopify’s recent AI headlines plug into a stronger run, with a 26.4% 1‑month share price return and a 55.6% gain over 90 days, while the 3‑year total shareholder return of about 2.6x signals that long-term holders have already seen substantial upside.

headlines.title: e.l.f. Beauty (ELF) As Shopify App News Meets A Fully Valued Narrative
headlines.summary: e.l.f. Beauty (ELF) has drawn attention after poq, which powers its native mobile apps, was recognized as a Shopify Certified Technology Partner. This development highlights a fresh angle on how investors might think about the stock. Recent headlines around e.l.f. Beauty span poq’s Shopify certification, a Kuromi collaboration on Roblox and an upcoming Q2 FY2027 earnings webcast. These touchpoints are landing against a strong backdrop of share price momentum.

headlines.title: Shopify Down 3% as ATB Cormark Downgrades the Stock After a 56% Three-Month Run
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysShopify shares fell 3% today after ATB Cormark downgraded the stock to Sector Perform from Outperform, with a C$234 price target. The downgrade follows a 56% run in three months, driven by AI shopping partnerships, including Meta’s Muse deal.

headlines.title: Shopify-Like IPO Successes Becoming Rare in Canada, Nowlan Says
headlines.summary: Canada will struggle to find another stock-market success story like Shopify Inc. as the country grapples with a public-listing drought and a delisting trend, according to Daniel Nowlan at National Bank Capital Markets.

headlines.title: Shopify (SHOP) is an Incredible Growth Stock: 3 Reasons Why
headlines.summary: Shopify (SHOP) possesses solid growth attributes, which could help it handily outperform the market.

description: Shopify Inc., a commerce technology company, provides tools to start, scale, market, and run a business of various sizes in Canada, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. The Company offers Shopify platform that enables merchants to manage products and inventory, process orders and payments, fulfill and ship orders, build customer relationships, source products, leverage analytics, and reporting and access financing for running their business across all of their sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts, and marketplaces. It also provides Shopify Payments, a fully integrated payment processing service that allows merchants to accept and process payment cards online and offline. In addition, the company engages in the sale of themes and apps; shipping labels through Shopify Shipping; point-of-sale hardware; advertising on the Shopify App Store; and Shop Campaigns for buyer acquisitions, as well as registration of domain names. The company was formerly known as Jaded Pixel Technologies Inc. and changed its name to Shopify Inc. in November 2011. Shopify Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Ottawa, Canada.
